whenToUse: Venue, food or project photos on a website: mosaic, filmstrip, equal grid or sticky caption.
Server-rendered photo sections that open the Lightbox.
avoidWhen: Admin media management — use Gallery grid or Media library.
A single feature image beside text — use Media + text.
a11y: Every photo has descriptive alt text; the section has a heading.
Filmstrip scrolling works with keyboard and has visible controls.
